name: portfolio
description: Personal portfolio of Glenn Wenand Arsemel Adorio — Computer Engineering Graduate & IT Professional

scripts.build: npm run sync-vendor && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const html=fs.readFileSync('index.html','utf8'); if(!html.includes('</html>')||!html.includes('</body>')) throw new Error('Missing closing HTML/BODY tags'); if(/toggleGameMode|Game Mode|car\.png|joystick/i.test(html)) throw new Error('Game Mode reference found'); fs.rmSync('public',{recursive:true,force:true}); fs.mkdirSync('public',{recursive:true}); for(const item of ['index.html','css','js','assets','logo.png','profile.jpg','profile-hover.jpg','3d-model.jpg','actual-model.jpg','specification.jpg','video-poster.jpg']){ fs.cpSync(item,'public/'+item,{recursive:true}); } console.log('Build verification passed and public/ directory generated.');"

author: Glenn Wenand Arsemel Adorio
